steps.title: Cru works on its own
steps.body: Switch on Cru on its own in Settings, Voice assistant, and tick what it may do while you're away: chats, cards, notes, services, jobs. Anything else comes to your phone to approve or decline. Stop everything pauses it all at once. Cru can also take a card and see it through with a Claude chat, and it saves the steps of longer jobs as routines it can follow again.

steps.title: Cru's heartbeat
steps.body: A built-in ticker that has Cru look round every 30 minutes, from 8 am to 10 pm. It goes through a short checklist you and Cru keep, checks its jobs, and stays silent unless something needs you. It's off until you or Cru switch it on, and with nothing on the checklist it costs nothing.

keys: Keep an eye on the web service

steps.title: Teach Cru your short replies
steps.body: In Settings, Voice assistant, Your voice, choose Teach short replies and say yes, no, go ahead, stop and a few more, three times each. Cru can then tell it's you from a single word, so a quick yes or no just works. Admin mode still needs a full sentence.
